name: dsh-codex-canvas
description: DeepSeek Harness tool plugin: image generation (gpt-image-2) via the Codex CLI, with inline Web preview

comments.runtime-deps: Deliberately none: @deepseek-ai/* resolve at runtime through the profile parent-walk to the dsh installation fallback (~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules), which is healed to the SAME dsh version as the running CLI. Bundling npm copies here would mix an old dsh-tools/dsh-jobs runtime with the new registry and break (observed: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading prepare)').
comments.typecheck: The @deepseek-ai devDependencies are compile-time only. dsh-client-ui-tool, dsh-client-connection, and dsh-client-runtime pull unpublished dependency closures from npm, so types/ holds minimal structural shims for the slices this plugin consumes; everything else typechecks against the published packages.
comments.client-half: dsh.client declares the browser bundle; the harness client-module system serves exports["./client"] at /plugins/dsh-codex-canvas/client.js and executes it through window.__ModuleLoader__. The same cordis.patch.yml row activates both halves.
